name: What should I do with the space after my tub is removed?

mainEntity.name: What should I do with the space after my tub is removed?

acceptedAnswer.text: After tub removal, you have several options for transforming your bathroom space. Many homeowners opt for a shower conversion, installing a new walk-in shower or a shower pan and tile surround. Alternatively, you could replace it with a new, more modern tub or a clawfoot tub. Some might choose to expand their vanity area, add storage, or even create a larger open space, depending on the bathroom layout and their personal needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: After tub removal, you can convert to a shower, install a new tub, expand your vanity, or create more open space.
